goal: Step-(a) extension #3 of the genesis-seed `History` producer. Discharge the `ProtocolCreditEnvelope.Ledger` ingredient in the fully-trivial seed case (`deposit.call.world = exit.world = GenesisFundingWorld.world`), reducing the caller's construction obligation from six ingredients to three (in the seed + zero-count + trivial-ledger combination).
review_scope: New theorem `ledger_genesis_trivial : ProtocolCreditEnvelope.Ledger GenesisFundingWorld.world 0 0 0 0 GenesisFundingWorld.world`: directly given by `ProtocolCreditEnvelope.Ledger.initial`, a constructor of the `Ledger` inductive that produces the trivial ledger with all-zero counters and identical initial/final worlds (see ProtocolCreditEnvelope.lean:48-49).

New theorem `exists_seed_trivial`: extends `exists_seed_zero_counts` by additionally taking `exitSeed : exit.world = GenesisFundingWorld.world`, so the `ledger` ingredient (which had type `Ledger GenesisFundingWorld.world 0 0 0 0 exit.world`) is now discharged via `rw [exitSeed]; exact ledger_genesis_trivial`. Requires only three explicit ingredients from the caller: `depositInputs`, `exitInputs`, `linked`.

Axioms: `ledger_genesis_trivial` and `exists_seed_trivial` both depend on `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` (verified locally via `lake env lean --run Eip8282/Audit/Trust.lean`). No new axioms introduced. Whitelist-compliant.

Semantic effect: in the fully-trivial seed case (`deposit.call.world = GenesisFundingWorld.world` AND `exit.world = GenesisFundingWorld.world` AND pow=withdrawals=migrations=0), the six required ingredients to build `History` reduce to three (`depositInputs`, `exitInputs`, `linked`), discharging `prior` (via `Trace.initial`), `counts` (via `counts_zero`), AND `ledger` (via `ledger_genesis_trivial`).

Public consumer signatures unchanged. This is a step-(a) sub-obligation removal — reduces caller construction burden from 6→3, but does not modify `ReferenceFullFeeBlockTotal.verified` or `ReferenceCheckedSystemBlock.verified` signatures. The `history` premise is still bare on both public consumers.
